turns.q: How many PMAY-G houses in total, and how many completed?
turns.answer:
PMAY-G — Meghalaya (statewide), across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24):
- PMAY-G houses: 1,71,107 (including 126 registered with a sanctioned amount of ₹0 and no house sanctioned yet)
- Completed houses: 1,29,941
- In progress (House Sanctioned, Plinth or Roof Cast): 41,041
- Not started or no status recorded (Proposed Site, Existing site or no status): 125
turns.sql:
SELECT
  'MEGHALAYA' AS entity_key,
  'Meghalaya' AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay

SELECT
  village_code AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_village_name) AS name,
  MAX(lgd_block) AS block,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS district,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,

    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,

    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'

turns.q: How many houses are still incomplete in Ri Bhoi?
turns.answer: Houses not yet completed in Ri Bhoi, across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 5,509. This is the PMAY-G figure across all financial years.
turns.sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_district) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,

turns.q: How many PMAY-G houses are there in Ampathi constituency?
turns.answer: PMAY-G houses in Ampathi assembly constituency, across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 3,409.
turns.sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(ac_name) AS entity_key,
  MAX(ac_name) AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay
WHERE
  UPPER(ac_name) = ANY(
    ARRAY['AMPATHI']
  )
GROUP BY
  UPPER(ac_name)

    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0

  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE

  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE

  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE

  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,

  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE

  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'

    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,

    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site

turns.q: How many PMAY-G houses have been completed in Eastern West Khasi Hills?
turns.answer: Completed houses in Eastern West Khasi Hills, across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 4,465. This is the PMAY-G figure across all financial years.
turns.sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_district) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay
WHERE
  UPPER(lgd_district) = ANY(
    ARRAY['EASTERN WEST KHASI HILLS']
  )
GROUP BY
  UPPER(lgd_district)

turns.q: How many PMAY-G houses are completed in Songsak block?
turns.answer: Completed houses in Songsak block, across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 4,850. This is the PMAY-G figure across all financial years.
turns.sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_block) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_block) AS name,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS district,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay
WHERE
  UPPER(lgd_block) = ANY(
    ARRAY['SONGSAK']
  )
GROUP BY
  UPPER(lgd_block)

  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE

  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'

  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE

turns.q: What percentage of PMAY-G houses in Ri Bhoi are completed?
turns.answer: Completion rate in Ri Bhoi, across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 68.64%. This is the PMAY-G figure across all financial years.
turns.sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_district) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay
WHERE
  UPPER(lgd_district) = ANY(
    ARRAY['RI BHOI']
  )
GROUP BY
  UPPER(lgd_district)

turns.q: How many PMAY-G houses were sanctioned?
turns.answer: PMAY-G houses in Meghalaya (statewide), across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 1,71,107 (including 126 registered with a sanctioned amount of ₹0 and no house sanctioned yet).
turns.sql:
SELECT
  'MEGHALAYA' AS entity_key,
  'Meghalaya' AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay

turns.q: How many PMAY-G houses were completed in 2020-21?
turns.answer: Completed houses in Meghalaya (statewide), of the houses sanctioned in FY 2020-21: 20,664. This is the PMAY-G figure.
turns.sql:
SELECT
  'MEGHALAYA' AS entity_key,
  'Meghalaya' AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay
WHERE
  year_key = 2020

turns.sql:
SELECT
  'MEGHALAYA' AS entity_key,
  'Meghalaya' AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE

    status_name = 'Plinth'

  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE

    AND sanctioned_amount > 0

  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
